Senses.Explanation: Drawing back the tongue is what even Linji is said to do before an overwhelming display, and it is also a direct command to stop the offered wording and bring another question. Xiatang Huiyuan answers a request to speak beyond the four propositions with 'draw back your tongue; bring a question,' while Zhenxie Qingliao dismisses a cited saying with 'draw back your tongue; raise another.' The recurring verse pairs Linji's withdrawn tongue with Deshan putting away his staff, making curtailed speech and curtailed action parallel.
